events.description: A cliff of {tokens[0]} tokens was unlocked from Genesis Liquidity on {timestamp}

notes: A one-time genesis mint of 1,000 SLVR seeded the launch: 880 paired with ETH for the initial liquidity pool, 80 to team vesting and 40 to the growth fund (included in the Team and Growth Fund on-chain tracking).

Grid Lottery Rewards.methodology: Each resolved game round mints 1 SLVR to the winning square, tracked via Transfer events from the zero address to the SlvrGridLottery contracts.

grid-lottery.name: Grid Lottery Rewards
grid-lottery.methodology: Each resolved game round mints 1 SLVR to the winning square, tracked via Transfer events from the zero address to the SlvrGridLottery contracts.

Team Vesting.methodology: 8% of all newly minted SLVR goes to the SlvrTeamVesting contract, tracked via Transfer events from the zero address.

team-vesting.name: Team Vesting
team-vesting.methodology: 8% of all newly minted SLVR goes to the SlvrTeamVesting contract, tracked via Transfer events from the zero address.

Growth Fund.methodology: 4% of all newly minted SLVR goes to the growth fund, tracked via Transfer events from the zero address.

growth-fund.name: Growth Fund
growth-fund.methodology: SLVR minted from the zero address to the SlvrGrowthFund contract (4% of every mint, including the genesis mint).
